title: A WebAssembly loop that waits for the paint event
blurb: A C program with a blocking main loop and a blocking modal dialog, drawing real elements with drawElementImage(). JSPI suspends it between paint events. Plus one edge filter as a WebNN graph and as C.
question: Can a C program draw DOM elements from a main loop that blocks on the canvas paint event, and show a modal dialog of real buttons from a nested blocking loop?
result: Yes, with JavaScript Promise Integration: two JavaScript calls and no async code in C. The WebNN part could not be measured, navigator.ml is missing in the test browsers.
